exclusions.reason: Godot 4.4.1 compatibility and end-to-end import, instantiation, node-count and renderability have not been proven. The inspected source declares EXT_meshopt_compression and KHR_mesh_quantization as required extensions.
reentryCriteria: Convert the source without unsupported compression extensions, or document a supported importer path.
Preserve and compare geometry, materials, skeleton and animation clips.
Pass the real Godot 4.4.1 import gate.
Instantiate with child node count greater than zero.
Pass MeshInstance3D surface and non-empty bounds checks.
Pass the complete resource validation report before re-entry.
